name: productpanda
description: Ask what your product is, where users get stuck, what the engineering risks are, how you compare with competitors, and what changed on the default branch. It can also write a skill set for the product into the repository. The server is read only.

interface.longDescription: Connects ChatGPT and Codex to a Product Panda organization. Ask what the product is, where users get stuck, what the engineering risks are, how it compares with competitors, and what changed on the default branch. It can also write a skill set for the product into the repository. The server is read only.
defaultPrompt: What does this product do, and who is it for?
What are the biggest engineering risks?
What changed on the default branch this week?
